best_idea: One ordered validity gate decides which class a character may take: base classes are open to every race, specialist classes need the native race or its unlock, and a cosmetic look never changes access.
decision_why: Keep the single ordered gate and the open base tier; drop the look bypass (menu.cpp:611-613) and the enum-arithmetic fallback (menu.cpp:2190); read unlocks from the server ledger, never the client.
acceptance: A test shows no cosmetic look changes which classes a character can take, and a server test refuses a specialist class without the native race or server-side unlock and accepts it with either, for every race.
